General & Multi-Discipline · Revit Add-in

Door Data Sync

Update Revit door data from a SQL Server workflow.

Export door data to SQL Server, make external edits, and sync supported values back to the corresponding Revit doors using their UniqueId.

Request Demo on WhatsApp Compare Workflows
Key features

Keep each external record tied to its Revit door

Door schedules can change after data is shared with another team. Use the Revit UniqueId to match the return update to the original element and review the import counts.

  • 01

    Auto Table Creation

    Instantly creates a 'Doors' table with correct schemas in SQL Server with verification to prevent duplicates

  • 02

    Comprehensive Export

    Scans the project and exports key door parameters — UniqueId, FamilyType, Mark, and Finish

  • 03

    Smart Import & Sync

    Reads updated values from the SQL database and updates the corresponding Revit elements using the UniqueId as a primary key

  • 04

    Duplicate Prevention

    Safe primary key handling skips already-exported elements without throwing errors

  • 05

    Read-Only Protection

    Safely skips read-only parameters without breaking the synchronization process

  • 06

    Connect to a configured SQL Server instance with Windows Authentication.

  • 07

    Instant Progress Logs

    Provides real-world success notifications showing the count of elements exported or updated

Workflow comparison

Manual Revit vs. Door Data Sync

TaskManual Revit workflowWith Door Data Sync
Prepare door data for handoffManual Revit workflowCreate and export a door schedule, then prepare it for the receiving system.With Door Data SyncCreate the Doors table and export door records to SQL Server.
Return external updatesManual Revit workflowMatch changed records back to the model and update supported values.With Door Data SyncImport updated values and match them to doors by Revit UniqueId.
Review what changedManual Revit workflowCompare exports and model values for missed or duplicated records.With Door Data SyncReview export and update counts. Existing records and read-only parameters are handled by the workflow.
